separation as to all former Federal em­
ployees who were separated from their  
positions during the period June 30,1932,  
to July 26, 1937, solely because of the  
operation of section 213 of the Economy  
Act of June 30,1932 (47 Stat. 382, 406).
This order is issued so that such  
former employees may be accorded an  
additional period of time-eligibility for  
reinstatement, under the Civil Service  
Rules, commensurate to the period which  
they would otherwise have had but which  
was rendered ineffective between the  
dates of separation and the date of repeal  
of section 213, supra.

Service Commission.
